title: Mapped Motor
text: Mapped motor and drive electronics operating in torque-control mode, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Parameterized by} sets Parameterization method for torque; {Port configuration}, {Import Torque Limits Calibration} sets the method to directly import torque limits calibration tables, {Calibrate Maps} sets the method to calibrate loss table with measured data, {Import Loss Calibration} sets the method to directly import loss calibration table, {Import Efficiency Calibration} sets the method to directly import efficiency calibration table, {Speed breakpoints for maximum torque, w_t} sets the rotational speeds, {Maximum torque values, T_t} sets the torque, {Maximum torque, torque_max} sets the torque, {Maximum power, power_max} sets the power, {Torque control time constant, Tc} sets the time constant, {Maximum torque as a function of speed and voltage, Tmax_w_V} sets the torque, {Speed breakpoints for maximum torque, w_Tmax_bp} sets the rotational speeds, {Voltage breakpoints for maximum torque, V_Tmax_bp} sets the voltage, {Minimum torque as a function of speed and voltage, Tmin_w_V} sets the torque, {Speed breakpoints for minimum torque, w_Tmin_bp} sets the rotational speeds, {Voltage breakpoints for minimum torque, V_Tmin_bp} sets the voltage, {Parameterize losses by} sets the parameterization method for electrical losses Single efficiency, {Motor and drive overall efficiency, eff} sets the combined efficiency η 0 of the motor and motor drive, measured at the efficiency setpoint, {Speed at which efficiency is measured, w_eff} sets the speed, {Torque at which efficiency is measured, T_eff}, {Iron losses, Piron} sets the power, {Fixed losses independent of torque and speed, Pbase} sets the power, {Speed breakpoints for losses, w_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Torque breakpoints for losses, T_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Temperature breakpoints for losses, Temp_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Voltage breakpoints for losses, V_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Loss table, losses_table} sets the 2-D lookup table M -by, {Loss table, losses_table_3d} sets the 3-D lookup table M -by- N -by, {Loss table, losses_table_4d} sets the 4-D lookup table N -by- M -by- K -by- L, {Efficiency table, efficiency_table} sets the 2-D lookup table M -by, {Efficiency table, efficiency_table_3d} sets the 3-D lookup table M -by- N -by, {Efficiency table, efficiency_table_4d} sets the 4-D lookup table N -by- M -by- K -by- L, {Rotor inertia, J} sets the inertia 5e-6, {Rotor damping, b} sets the damping 1e-5 and {Initial rotor speed, omega_o} sets the speed. Values come from the instance.
